name: Sunhollow Orchard
tagline: Three generations of peaches, apricots and plums on a south-facing hillside.
imageAlt: Ripe peaches on a sunlit branch
description: A family-run farm stand in Sebastopol, CA, Sunhollow Orchard grows Peaches, Apricots, Nectarines, Plums, and Cherries. The stand is busiest in summer. It follows certified organic, dry-farmed, and solar-powered pack house practices. It has been growing since 1971. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Aug in this growing zone.
